name: Swoop Hunting
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt.  A collection of Swoop Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a hunter.

If you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop.

Bring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan.

The swoops may be found anywhere in Mulgore, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.
narrative.objectives: Bring 8 Trophy Swoop Quills to Harken Windtotem in Bloodhoof Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: I know that gathering these quills was not an easy task, adventurer. In doing this, you prove that you are a Champion of merit. It is good to have you at Bloodhoof Village.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you found the swoops, adventurer.  Do you have their quills?
